# Top Speed Appliance Repair

> Top Speed Appliance Repair is the repair site of Top Speed Appliance LLC — same-day appliance repair and installation across Broward County and Florida's tri-county area. Every request goes into Top Speed Service OS and is confirmed by a real person in the Service Setters office.

## Contact

- Phone: (844) 460-7038
- Office: 6810 N State Rd 7, Suite 341, Coconut Creek, FL 33073
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- Website: https://topspeedappliancerepair.com/

## Services

- Refrigerator repair
- Washer repair
- Dryer repair
- Oven and range repair
- Dishwasher repair
- Freezer and ice maker repair
- Microwave repair
- Garbage disposal repair
- Appliance installation

## Pricing (residential)

- Diagnostic: $99, collected at booking and credited toward your approved repair. The diagnostic is still due if the repair is declined.
- Repair labor: $210 flat.
- Installation labor: $150 flat.
- Parts and materials are priced in a written quote. No work is done without an approved written quote.
- Commercial and property-management service is priced by custom quote — see Appliance Pro (https://www.appliancepro.net/).

## Coverage

- 65 cities across Broward (31), Palm Beach (16) and Miami-Dade (18) counties are matched automatically when booking; 104 city pages are published in total.
- Coverage directory: https://topspeedserviceos.com/service-areas-directory/

## Booking

- Book online with the classic booking form at https://topspeedappliancerepair.com/ — the form is the primary path. Speedy, the AI assistant, is available on the main platform (https://topspeedserviceos.com/) for questions and photo diagnosis.
- Every job is confirmed by a human Service Setter and tracked live from request to completion.
- Refer & Earn program: https://topspeedserviceos.com/refer

## Network partner

- Dryer vent cleaning is handled by Cleanout Vents, the Top Speed network's registered vent partner, reachable through Top Speed at (844) 460-7038. Vent services are quoted by Cleanout Vents; Top Speed does not publish vent prices.
